entries.title: Three days where “running” was not progress
entries.summary: Two game efforts were hit by a silent-stall failure: MiniTZ could look alive while productive work was not actually advancing. The founder reports roughly three days of lost or blocked time before the failure became explicit engineering law.
entries.evidence_summary: Founder incident report establishes the human cost. Preserved source history records “remove nonfunctional progress stalls” (b340cdd2) and “rotate silent stalled executors” (49ec2d9a). The later production-system record explicitly attributes observed waste, stalls and incorrect continuation to the 2026-09-07/08 production window and forbids the failure patterns.

entries.title: Before the OS, there was the assistant

entries.title: The idea became: make it the OS
